kind: automated consistency check (not a human review)

family-022.note: Same situation as design-family-012 (an activity's only permitted window fully covered by a mandatory closure of its group), but labelled hard_window_has_no_placement while design-family-012 uses resolve_hard_conflict. A method cannot know which code is expected. One of the two families should change so both use one code, as v2.1 did for missing_day.

design-family-012.note: See family-022: same pattern, different clarification code.

design-family-009.note: Unlike family-020, the statement does not say 'exactly' or 'do not round'. A room closure of 10:00-12:00 blocks exactly the same teaching period (10:15-11:45) because adjoining intervals do not overlap, so 'ready' with room_unavailable 10-12 is a defensible reading. The guide says not to round, so 'unsupported' follows the guide; a human should confirm the guide rule is intended for this case.

family-004.note: arz uses 'حاسبات' and ar 'بالسنة الثانية علوم حاسب', neither an exact context alias; the meaning is clear, but resolution relies on paraphrase, not the alias list.

design-family-003.note: ar says 'حضور المحاضرات' (attend lectures), narrower than 'classes' in en/arz/mixed; a reader could take it to exclude labs or tutorials.

design-family-007.note: Also gives no day; undefined_early alone is enough because no time can be built until 'early' is defined, but a method that also asks for a day is not wrong in spirit.
